content.title: Vail Resorts Says Season-Pass Sales for Upcoming Ski Season Are Down
content.summary: Vail Resorts  said it sold fewer passes for the coming ski season after it failed to keep pace with shifting consumer behavior.  Chief Executive  Rob Katz  said the ski-resort operator hasn’t lived up to its full growth potential, particularly on revenue growth, including in its expectations for the year ahead.  “At the heart of our underperformance is that the way we are connecting with guests has not kept pace with the rapidly evolving consumer landscape,” Katz said during a call with analysts.
